text.title: FreshDrop team, 6 experts from logistics and retail, 20 August 2026
text.hypothesis: courier delays are caused by the slot model, not by the route; the slot decision depends on it
text.experts: 2 former courier managers, 2 category managers, 2 logistics analysts; 6 people
text.format: interview, 60 minutes each; led by the product lead, notes by the analyst
text.q1: How long does a courier wait at a slot in a dense district?
text.q2: Where does a late delivery start: in the slot or in the route?
text.q3: What would you fix first in a delivery service?
text.q4: What do buyers complain about most?
text.a2: «The slot, the route is fine» (logistics analyst)
text.c4: calls matter as much as time
text.gaps: no experts from the Saint Petersburg market; numbers are from memory
text.decision: fix the slot model before the route algorithm
text.check: fewer late deliveries in the pilot districts over 4 weeks
